name: yaseen-milkdown
description: Yaseen Docs: local markdown editor as an Electron desktop app (React + Milkdown Crepe renderer, main-process file layer)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
